survey: A saguaro-style cactus stands upright in sand dunes, seen from slightly above with the horizon at about two-thirds of the trunk's height. Main parts: (1) A tall ribbed cylindrical trunk with a rounded dome top and a pink flower on a small green collar at the top. The trunk is vertical, and its vertical ribs bunch together toward the left and right edges as the cylinder turns away. (2) The left arm comes out of the trunk's left side, partly hidden behind the trunk's edge. It bends upward in a smooth elbow and ends in a dome whose ribs meet at the tip. (3) The right arm comes out of the trunk's right side and its joint overlaps the front of the trunk a little, so it sits slightly closer to the viewer. It bends up to a ribbed dome tip. On both arms the ribs wrap around the elbow curve. (4) The spines sit in vertical rows along the ribs, and those on the side outlines point outward, which matches the cylinder's surface. (5) Ground: the sand dunes and rocks are seen from a gentle height above. The trunk's base meets the sand with a slightly downward-curving outline and a soft contact shadow, which fits a camera that looks slightly down at the ground.
